subject: Re: UChicago Incubator — pilot credits & packaging request
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@uchicago.edu>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@uchicago.edu
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0500
Subject: UChicago Incubator: pilot credits + custom packaging request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this — I manage partnerships for the University of Chicago Incubator and we
are evaluating Redwood for a winter cohort pilot. A few constraints on our side:

- We need an initial 6-month pilot that covers up to ~40M tokens (estimated).
- Requesting a promotional credit grant or one-time pilot allowance (target value ~$15k) to
  cover the first 2 months of heavy experimentation.
- EDU procurement requires either a short PO (we can do one) or a master agreement; billing
  timing is quarterly.
- Data residency and SOC 2 evidence will be required for our security review.
- We may ask for limited usage-based discounts once we transition from pilot to paid.

Is there room for an exception from your standard accelerator package (many vendors offer fixed
cohort bundles)? Ideally we want predictable unit economics for founders while the incubator
sponsors exploration. If this is possible, can you also send a redlined MAP or sample SOW
we can share with our legal?

Quick call would be great — I'm available Mon/Tue afternoons CT.

Best,
Samantha Li
Partnerships Manager — UChicago Incubator

(312) 555-0148

From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear context and timeline. Really excited about the possibility of
working with UChicago founders. Quick reply with next steps and two pragmatic options so you can
share with procurement/legal: 

1) Accelerator Starter (fast option) — standard cohort package we typically offer: 50,000 free
   token-credits valid for 3 months plus access to our onboarding playbook and 2 hrs of SE time.

2) Pilot Plus (bespoke) — for incubators that need more runway: 75,000 token-credits split over
   6 months, plus a 20% unit-price discount for the first 3 months after credits are exhausted.

We can also do a smaller one-time promotional allowance (~$15k value) if the incubator will
commit to a vendor spotlight and a short case study at the program end. Any custom exception
would need finance approval and a short MAP (mutual action plan) that lays out invoicing and PO
terms.

I've attached a short teaser of our accelerator terms and a MAP template to speed reviews.
Can you confirm: PO or PO-exempt desk? Also, please send the security contact so we can push
SOC2 evidence.

If it helps, I'm free Tue 14:30-16:30 CT for a 30-min sync. I cc'd Ben (partnerships lead) and
Aditya (sales engineering) to loop them in on packaging and technical constraints.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai

Rachel — quick internal: I've reviewed the numbers and options. We can approve the Pilot Plus
path on the following internal guardrails:

- Approve up to 75k credits split over 6 months (as non-recurring promotional allowance).
- Add a 25% uplift to the overage discount for the first 90 days after credits are used (caps
  at $5k incremental exposure).
- Require a signed MAP and a short SOW that clarifies PoC success criteria to avoid open-ended
  commitments.

Finance will want the SOW and expected spend profile before final sign-off; legal will need to
confirm the PO path vs. master services. Aditya — can you confirm the technical ceilings for
40M tokens (latency SLA, recommended batching, and whether KV caching will reduce token cost)?

If we proceed, I'll draft an internal approval note for discounts and record the deal id.

—Ben

Hi Samantha — following internal approvals, here's a concise proposal for the incubator to
review and share with procurement/legal. I've attached a formal proposal and our SOC 2 bundle.

Summary of options (choose one):

Option A — Quick Cohort
- 50,000 token-credits, valid for 3 months
- Standard onboarding (2 SE hours)
- No procurement exceptions; standard T&Cs apply

Option B — Incubator Pilot Plus (recommended)
- 75,000 token-credits spread across 6 months (non-recurring grant)
- 20% unit discount for the first 90 days after credits are consumed
- We can add a $15k promotional allowance in exchange for a post-pilot case study and
  co-marketing call (optional)
- Requires signed MAP and a PO or agreed billing cadence; finance to approve SOW before
  formal issuance

Next steps:
1) If Option B looks good, I'll send a draft MAP and a DocuSign link for a non-binding SOW
   (we need expected token profile for month 1 and month 2).
2) Procurement: please confirm whether UChicago will raise a PO or needs an updated MSLA.
3) Security: please route SOC2 contact to security@redwood.ai (attached SOC2 artifacts).

I've attached: proposal-uchicago-20260915.pdf (proposal + pricing table) and a SOC2 evidence
zip. If you sign off by Sep 22 we can onboard the cohort before winter term start.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call Wed afternoon CT if you want to walk through the proposal.
